rationale: The tape is two-sided and unresolved: price has bounced hard off $39.62 and reclaimed the prior close ($41.85), but it is stalling in a tight 11-cent band just under $42.35, with the newest candle fading on the heaviest volume of the sequence while sitting well below the anchored session VWAP ($43.05) yet above the short-term 5-min VWAP ($40.97). Neither a VWAP-rejection short nor a continuation long has a trigger — the 5m ATR has compressed to a nickel and price is pinned mid-structure between reclaimed support and overhead supply with only 52 minutes left, so expected value on either side is close to a coin flip. Standing aside until a clean break of $42.35 (long continuation) or loss of $42.10/$41.85 (short resolution) presents itself.
